question: Zinc and Cadmium are sensitive only to ultraviolet light, whereas Alkali metals like Lithium and Sodium are sensitive to visible light. What fundamental property difference accounts for this variation in photosensitivity?

options.A: Alkali metals have a lower work function, allowing lower energy photons to cause emission
options.B: Zinc and Cadmium have a lower melting point, making them less stable under visible light
options.C: Alkali metals are better electrical insulators, which traps the light energy
options.D: Zinc and Cadmium have a higher density of free electrons than Alkali metals
